assertions.assertion: The denial carries CARC code CO-97.
The service at issue is CPT 93271.
CPT 93271 corresponds to a cardiac event monitoring study.
The study was ordered for this patient.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has recurrent episodes of lightheadedness.
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.0.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
Personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction is coded Z86.73.
G45.9 is a diagnosis code on the case associated with transient ischemic attack.
The study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events.
The study was ordered to guide anticoagulation management.
The documented findings support the medical necessity of CPT 93271 for this episode.
Reconsideration of the CO-97 denial is requested.
